reason: Provides gate code and key location for accessing physical equipment sites TRN-042 and BTS-233.

knowledge.summary: The private road to TRN-042 and BTS-233 has a locked barrier; the key is in a lockbox at the neighbouring red house with code 2580.
knowledge.author: Tiina Tuominen
knowledge.details: Key located in a lockbox at the neighbouring farm (red house right before the barrier), lockbox code is 2580.
